briefdescription.para: Create a location whose rule is set to Unspecified.

detaileddescription.para: This means the register value might be in the same register but it wasn't specified in the unwind opcodes.

briefdescription.para: Create a location where the value is undefined and not available.

detaileddescription.para: This can happen when a register is volatile and can't be recovered.

briefdescription.para: Create a location where the value is known to be in the register itself.
Create a location that is in (Deref == false) or at (Deref == true) the CFA plus an offset.

detaileddescription.para:
Most registers that are spilled onto the stack use this rule. The rule for the register will use this rule and specify a unique offset from the CFA with Deref set to true. This value will be relative to a CFA value which is typically defined using the register plus offset location.
createRegisterPlusOffset(...) for more information.

detaileddescription.para: The CFA is usually defined using this rule by using the stack pointer or frame pointer as the register, with an offset that accounts for all spilled registers and all local variables in a function, and Deref == false.
